The following factors shall be used to evaluate offers: Lowest Price Technically Acceptable - Offers will be ranked lowest to highest according to price. A price analysis will be conducted to determine whether the lowest price will result from a single award or multiple awards. Based on the price analysis, the lowest price offer or multiple offers, will be forwarded to the requiring activity for technical evaluation (offer(s), in accordance with the specifications, will be deemed either technically acceptable or technically unacceptable). If the lowest price offer or offers is found technically acceptable and the pricing determined fair and reasonable by the Contracting Officer, evaluation will be deemed complete and award will be made based on the lowest price offer(s). If the lowest price offer is determined technically unacceptable, another analysis will be conducted amongst the remaining offers to determine if a single or multiple awards will provide the lowest price. sla_onsite.text: contact information. Warranty The contractor shall provide a minimum manufacturer or contractor warranty covering parts and labor for the complete workstation configuration. Warranty coverage shall include the processor, motherboard, memory, storage devices, power supply, cooling components, chassis, and all four installed GPUs. The contractor shall identify warranty duration, support procedures, and replacement or repair timelines in its proposal. Contractor Responsibilities The contractor is responsible for verifying final component compatibility before shipment, including but not limited to: - CPU-to-motherboard compatibility; - PCIe lane availability and GPU slot configuration; - GPU physical dimensions and slot spacing; - Power draw and connector requirements; - Thermal performance under multi-GPU loads; - Chassis airflow and component clearance; and - Driver and operating-system compatibility. Any proposed substitutions shall meet or exceed the stated technical and performance requirements and shall not reduce four-GPU CUDA capability. ===== FILE: files/sam_http_resources.json ===== { "notice_id": "94664d8dffa44cc6a09db763b5beb89a", "resources": [ { "resource_id": "fdc07af7ee5c4beba7b77dde13750da8", "name": "Scope of Work.docx", "access": "0", "deleted"
